decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks (URL, ...)' and 'URLs auto-normalized'; client round 1: 'I can save ...'. Prototype review.
decisions.note: Saving a bookmark by URL is presented and conforms to REF-BM-01.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks (URL, title, description, tags)'; client: '... edit ...'. Prototype review.
decisions.note: Editing url/title/description/tags is presented and conforms to REF-BM-04 (note field belongs to REF-BM-23, tracked separately).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks'; client: '... remove bookmarks'. Prototype review.
decisions.note: Delete is presented and conforms to REF-BM-05.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Tags — comma-separated, with clickable filter chips'; client: '... organize ...'. Prototype review.
decisions.note: Assigning one or more tags is presented and conforms to REF-BM-09.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'clickable filter chips'; client: '... organize, find ...'. Prototype review.
decisions.note: Filtering to a specific tag via chips is presented and conforms to REF-BM-11.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Live search across title, URL, description, and tags'; client: '... find ...'. Prototype review.
decisions.note: Full-text search over title/description/url is presented and conforms to REF-BM-12 (note not searched because notes are absent — an equivalent effect given no note field).

decisions.evidence: Client round 1: 'I can ... open ... bookmarks'; maker presents a bookmark list UI. Prototype review.
decisions.note: Opening/navigating to the original URL from the list conforms to REF-BM-08 per the client's stated use.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: bookmark fields are manual '(URL, title, description, tags)' with no auto-collection, and metadata is offered only as future work: 'Want me to add anything — favicon/link previews ...'. Client round 1: 'I'm happy with the app as it is.' Prototype review.
decisions.note: Auto-collection of title/description/favicon/preview on save (REF-BM-02) is absent; the client gave only bare approval and did not express the expectation, so no capture.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Tags — comma-separated' free entry, no autocomplete mentioned. Client round 1: bare approval 'happy with the app as it is.' Prototype review.
decisions.note: Autocomplete of existing tags on entry (REF-BM-10) is absent; passes on bare approval with no expression of the difference.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: only 'Live search across title, URL, description, and tags' — a simple substring search, no #tag syntax / boolean-parenthesised operators / quoted-phrase matching. Client round 1: '... find ...' then 'happy with the app as it is.' Prototype review.
decisions.note: Advanced search features (#tag search, AND/OR/NOT + groups, exact quoted phrase) are absent; client bare approval does not surface the difference.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker offers but has not built: 'import/export (e.g. browser HTML bookmarks)'. Client round 1 ignores the offer: 'I'm happy with the app as it is.' Prototype review.
decisions.note: Netscape-HTML import/export (REF-BM-30/31) is absent and only offered; the client did not select it, and bare approval expresses no expectation, so unexpressed rather than a select-type capture.
